## What changes for users

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected devices.

## Verification

List automated checks and, for Bluetooth changes, device/firmware/macOS evidence. Distinguish device readback from audible behavior. Remove serial numbers and addresses.

## Authors and sources

- [ ] Every reused dependency, snippet, asset and protocol source has author/project credit.
- [ ] Original license and copyright notices are retained; modifications are documented.
- [ ] ACKNOWLEDGMENTS.md and generated copies/notices are updated where needed.
- [ ] Support claims match the testing performed.
